name: LatentComposite with linear feather
plain: Pastes one latent into another at an 8-pixel-grid offset. With feather on, it builds a linear ramp mask only on edges that do not touch the destination boundary. Corners multiply the two ramps, so they fall off faster than edges.
math:
x,y,feather are divided by 8.
feather=0: s[y:y+h,x:x+w] = from
else mask row/col t from each interior edge is multiplied by (t+1)/feather
out = from·mask + to·(1−mask)
